comment: Golden-hash parity vectors for the declared re-baseline.
hashdiff_expression is the bare expression macros/estate_evolution.sql renders from
automate_dv.hash over the basis with is_hashdiff=true; aliased_expression is the same
rendering before the alias is stripped. basis is written in declaration order, and the
expression shows the alphabetical order AutomateDV hashes in.
expected_hashdiff pins what DuckDB computes for each row, so a change in the hash
hashdiff_expression:
CAST(UPPER(MD5(CONCAT_WS('||',
    IFNULL(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(as_of_date AS VARCHAR))), ''), '^^'),
    IFNULL(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(list_price AS VARCHAR))), ''), '^^'),
    IFNULL(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(product_name AS VARCHAR))), ''), '^^'),
    IFNULL(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(product_note AS VARCHAR))), ''), '^^')
))) AS VARCHAR)
aliased_expression:
CAST(UPPER(MD5(CONCAT_WS('||',
    IFNULL(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(as_of_date AS VARCHAR))), ''), '^^'),
    IFNULL(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(list_price AS VARCHAR))), ''), '^^'),
    IFNULL(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(product_name AS VARCHAR))), ''), '^^'),
    IFNULL(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(product_note AS VARCHAR))), ''), '^^')
))) AS VARCHAR) AS dpf_rebaseline_hashdiff
